An applied business statistics course

Better decisions begin with better questions.

Learn to turn a business question into evidence you can explain, reproduce, and challenge.

Start with the dataFind your learning route →
About the case data. All ten business cases use fictional data generated from documented models and fixed seeds. The charts, estimates, and downloadable labs use those generated observations; they are not evidence about real firms, people, or markets. The known answers belong to each case’s assumed model. Use the stories to practice making decisions, then bring real data and a credible comparison to an actual business decision. The generation rules and code are in the data and labs.

Ten business lessons · Three depths of study

Your learning path.

Start with a business case. Continue through a connected business story with one worked calculation and its practical meaning. Use the technical appendix for generation rules, derivations and Python labs.
